title: Police release identify of Moncton man following shooting incident
article: RCMP responded to a complaint shortly before 6 a.m. Saturday of an armed man attempting to break into a vehicle near the Moncton Coliseum.
Police say officers fired their guns after tracking down the suspect in the Whitney Avenue - Jordan Avenue area of Moncton.
Police say Levesque, of Moncton, later died in hospital, but they could not confirm how he was killed because the matter remains under investigation.
The Fredericton Police Force is conducting the investigation.
They are asking anyone with information to call Fredericton Police or Crime Stoppers.
